recordedResultStamps.meaning: Abbreviation of git commit c99870178ce6ab: the build stamp the legacy getScannerVersion() wrote into results produced before the 2026-09-25 regeneration. It survives only on the 1,791 entries with no authorized body to rescan; the 9,606 entries that carry an engine identity carry 'scanner-beta-1' instead (9,385 readiness-derived plus the 221 published verdicts), and the 67 'not-scanned' rows carry neither. It is a build stamp, not an engine identity, so the gate declares it and does not compare against it.

SCANNER_VERSION in packages/scanner-core/src/scanner-version.ts: the engine identity that produced the 9,385 official and 288 redistributable verdicts published by the 2026-09-25 regeneration. It is the same constant check:scanner-goldens pins in RELEASE_GOLDEN_IDENTITY, and the value data/manifest.json metadata.scannerVersion carried before the 2026-10-20 v2 regeneration; the v2 release stamp is 2.0.0.

The acquirer's own 'no authorized source body could be re-established' marker, stamped by audit F-001 RULING-1 (option B) on 2026-09-27 on the 67 redistributable entries whose upstream repository murataslan1/n8n-workflow-collection was deleted (HTTP 404 on the authenticated API), so no body exists to rescan them against. It is a placeholder for a verdict that was never re-derived — not a build stamp and not an engine identity — and must never be read as a licence, a verdict, or a grade: the grade, score, counts and findings those rows still publish are the pre-regeneration verdicts and were left exactly as shipped. They also carry security.stampReason 'source_unavailable'; readiness.analysis publishes 'unscanned' because no body ships for them — the packs that used to hold those bodies were removed from the release by the 2026-09-27 regeneration. The same value is the existing legacy no-body marker in pipeline/derive/corpus-analytics.ts and pipeline/derive/verdict-adjudication.ts.

The admitted native v2 engine identity written to data/manifest.json metadata.scannerVersion for the 2026-10-20 regeneration. It is the release identity of the engine that produced the v2 receipts; scanner-beta-1 remains the source constant the goldens pin.

scope.searchableNote: The searchable projection is 11,245 = 2,000 (search-index.json) + 9,245 (search-index-extended.json) = facets.ordinals = facets.total. It is deliberately unchanged by the 2026-09-25 regeneration: the canonical vendor taxonomy leaves core-node workflows with an empty integrations list, so isSearchable/isIndexable now state their floor on structure.nodeTypes rather than on integrations. Measured on the pre-regeneration corpus both forms selected the same 11,245 entries, so no entry left the published surface.

rescan.bodiesBasis: 0 is the measured redistributable population on 2026-09-27, after audit F-001 RULING-2 (a755b85) flipped all 288 redistributable rows to link-only: no authorized body remains to rescan, so the gate-validated `bodies`/`identical`/`different`/`differentIds` are the empty scan and must stay at 0/0/0/[] because scripts/lib/scanner-result-freshness.mjs binds `bodies` to the measured redistributable count. The 288-body measurement that existed before the flip is preserved in `historical`, which the gate does not validate.

historical.note: The rescans actually performed before RULING-2 emptied the redistributable population, recorded at commit b3567a1 and left unaltered since. Not gate-validated: kept because it is real evidence and the flip must not erase it. `bodies`/`identical`/`different`/`differentIds` are the 2026-09-25 288-body rescan; `rescanned`/`stamped` and the `rescanned*` counts are what the 2026-09-27 publication then rescanned out of them.
historical.cause: Policy change under a stable identity, re-measured after the credential-plumbing fix (packages/scanner-core/src/policies/secret-indicators.ts: the parameter names `credentials` and `nodeCredentialType` are no longer classified as secret-bearing keys, though their children are still traversed). 41 differences in three classes, none of them input loss, ordering or nondeterminism: a second run over the same 288 bodies was byte-identical. (1) 15 differ only in hardenedExtra and stay inside the hardened-only report-only catalog (TAINTED_REQUEST_URL, TAINTED_AI_PROMPT, TAINTED_SQL_QUERY, AI_AGENT_UNGATED_TOOL); some moved upward, and a strictly reduced input cannot add findings, so the rules moved. (2) 26 entries lose credential-plumbing false positives: all 55 `parameters.nodeCredentialType` values across the 288 bodies (todoistApi, httpHeaderAuth, wordpressApi, pineconeApi, virusTotalApi, ... — the credential-type selector of the HTTP Request node) each carried a MEDIUM sensitive_key RAW_SECRET_INDICATOR, and none of them is secret material. Removing them lowers 21 published grades (7 HIGH -> MEDIUM, 14 MEDIUM -> LOW) and makes 1ae2123eca2f28cf reproduce exactly — that entry differed from its stored verdict only by the 11 findings this fix removes, so its stored HIGH/64 stands and the pre-fix engine's CRITICAL/100 was the false-positive escalation. (3) 3f5cb566cd98bc11 also picks up the Phase-1.3 expression-island detection on node 'MySQL Pass' (secretPath '=cyber-sentinel/credentials/mysql/app_manager'), a genuine detection improvement. That derivation did not restamp the stored verdicts — a release-owner decision at the time — so on 2026-09-25 all 55 false positives and the 21 inflated grades were still shipped. 168 commits touched the scanner sources after c998701. 2026-09-27 (P3-1b, audit F-001 RULING-1 B): the stored verdicts WERE restamped, for the 221 rows that can be rescanned. Each row's `security` block was replaced by the rescanned one under the engine identity `scanner-beta-1`; 188 of the 221 reproduce their stored verdict exactly and 33 change — 12 `report_only` (hardenedExtra only), 20 `false_positive_removed` (17 published grades lowered: 10 MEDIUM -> LOW, 7 HIGH -> MEDIUM) and 1 `mixed`. The 8 remaining differences of the 41 fall in the 67 stamped rows, which stay shipped unaltered because their upstream repository is gone — they cannot be rescanned, so their inflated grades stay published under the not-scanned stamp. The two rows the handoff named: `3f5cb566cd98bc11` is among the 221 and its published claim increases (one MEDIUM credential-plumbing false positive removed, one HIGH expression-island finding added on node `MySQL Pass`, grade CRITICAL -> CRITICAL, disposition `requires-owner-decision` — the ruling published it); `1ae2123eca2f28cf` is among the 221 and its stored HIGH/64 stands exactly, its ledger old and new digests being identical (sha256:ca6b8a4e3aa718ba5c51b8a3be7afce177d60f767c9d7c3e07a5e8dcbd51edd6).
